# Integrate Billing

The calls themselves: where they live, what they need in their headers, every operation, and one request written out in full.

## Hosts

- `https://api.eka.care`

## Auth and headers

Get a token first: [Authentication](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/auth/getting-started).

- `apiKeyAuth`: API key in the `auth` header.
- `auth`: API key in the `auth` header.

## Endpoints

1 operation, grouped by tag.

### Other

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | [`/dr/v1/payment/transaction_status/{transaction_id}`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/billing/get-transaction-status) | Get Transaction Status |

## One request in full

GET /dr/v1/payment/transaction_status/{transaction_id}, from [its page](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/billing/get-transaction-status).

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://api.eka.care/dr/v1/payment/transaction_status/{transaction_id}' \
  -H 'auth: <auth>' \
  -H 'auth: <auth>'
```
